app.name: TrafonDart
app.tagline: Darts scoring, ratings and tournaments for the crew

common.provisionalHint: Rating is still settling – it moves faster for the first matches.

auth.registerLead: You need an invite code from an admin in the group.
auth.realNameHint: Shown next to your username, e.g. Kari Nordmann.

home.noLiveLead: No matches are being played right now. Start one and the others can watch every dart.

match.newLead: Pick the players and the rules, then hand the tablet to the board.

outHint.DOUBLE: Finish on a double or the bull.
outHint.MASTER: Finish on a double, treble or the bull.

inHint.STRAIGHT: Every dart counts from the start.

match.outOfSync: Another device scored at the same time. Showing the latest state.
match.abandonConfirm: Abandon this match? It will not count for ratings or stats.
match.disputeLead: An admin will review it. If they agree, the match is voided and ratings are recalculated.
match.notScorer: Only the players or the person who set up the match can score it.

stats.noMatchesYet: No finished matches yet – the dashboard fills up after the first one.

players.title: Players
players.lead: Ordered by Glicko-2 rating. Ratings marked provisional are still settling.

tournament.title: Tournaments
tournament.lead: Round-robin leagues and knockout cups. Brackets fill themselves in as matches finish.
tournament.newLead: Pick a format and the players. Seeds are set by rating when you start.
tournament.name: Name

formatHints.ROUND_ROBIN: Everyone plays everyone once. Most points wins.
formatHints.SINGLE_ELIMINATION: Lose once and you're out. Top seeds get byes.

tournament.startHint: Starting generates all fixtures. Players can't be changed afterwards.
tournament.cancelConfirm: Cancel this tournament? Matches already played keep counting for ratings.
tournament.empty: No tournaments yet. Start the first one.

admin.title: Admin
admin.newInviteLead: Each code can be used a set number of times before it expires.
admin.inviteOnce: Copy it now – for security only a hash is stored, so it can't be shown again.
admin.revokeConfirm: Revoke this code? Nobody else can sign up with it.
admin.noDisputes: No reports. Everybody agrees on the scores.
admin.voidConfirm: Void this match? It disappears from stats and all ratings are recalculated.
admin.resetHow: Copy the link and send it, for example on Messenger. It works once, for 24 hours, and the person chooses a new password themselves and is logged in. You never see the password. All the person's other logins are ended, and any lock-out after wrong passwords is lifted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Saved to your account so it follows you to other devices.
settings.soundHint: Chimes for 180s, big finishes and busts.
settings.callerHint: Reads out every turn score, like on TV.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been logged out.
settings.logoutAllHint: Ends every session on every device, including this one.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to do that.
errors.CONFLICT: Something changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CSRF_INVALID: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server hit an error. Try again in a moment.
errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been disabled. Talk to an admin.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: That invite code doesn't exist. Check for typos.
errors.INVITE_EXPIRED: That invite code has expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
errors.INVITE_USED_UP: That invite code has been used up. Ask an admin for a new one.
errors.INVITE_REVOKED: That invite code was revoked. Ask an admin for a new one.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: There must always be at least one active admin.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You can't change your own role or access.
errors.MATCH_OUT_OF_SYNC: Another device scored at the same time. Showing the latest state.
errors.MATCH_NOT_SCORER: Only the players or the person who set up the match can score it.
errors.DISPUTE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only players in a finished match can report it.
errors.DISPUTE_ALREADY_OPEN: This match has already been reported.
errors.DISPUTE_TOURNAMENT_LOCKED: The winner has already played on in the tournament, so this match can't be voided.
errors.TOURNAMENT_TOO_FEW_PLAYERS: A tournament needs at least two players.
errors.TOURNAMENT_TOO_MANY_PLAYERS: A tournament can have at most 32 players.
errors.FIXTURE_NOT_READY: This fixture is waiting for earlier results.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. The free server may be waking up – give it a minute.
errors.KUDOS_OWN_MATCH: You can't give kudos to your own match.
errors.RESET_LINK_INVALID: This link doesn't work any more. Ask an admin for a new one.

social.ownMatch: You can't give kudos to your own match.
social.noComments: No comments yet. Be the first to say something about this match.

analysis.winProbabilityHint: Based on both players' Glicko-2 ratings when the match started.
analysis.scoreBandsHint: How many turns landed in each score range.
analysis.heatmapHint: Brighter segments were hit more often. Hover or tap a segment for the count.
analysis.raceHint: Remaining score after each turn in leg {{n}}.
analysis.h2hNone: This is their first match against each other.

nerd.title: Darts nerd corner
nerd.lead: Every dart this player has thrown in finished matches.
nerd.breakHint: Legs won when the opponent threw first

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Hi {{name}}! Pick a new password for @{{username}}. You'll be logged in straight away.
reset.invalidLead: Reset links work once and expire after 24 hours. Ask an admin for a new one.

feedback.title: Found a bug?
feedback.lead: Something broken, confusing or just wrong? Send an email and tell us about it.
feedback.include1: What you were trying to do
feedback.include3: Which page you were on, and your phone or browser
feedback.subject: TrafonDart: bug report

forgot.hint: Forgot your password? Ask an admin for a reset link.
